text:
Sara (PM): Quick async check — Q2 OKR milestone status. Please post: what shipped, what slipped, and immediate blockers. We'll collate for the roadmap doc. Short replies please.

Jamie (Eng): Shipped: runtime-v2 canary deployed to Dedicated pool A, p95 latency ~120ms on test traffic, load test passed. Link: https://git.redwood-inference.com/runtime/compare/..../canary :tada:

Devin (Eng): CR needed on perf tweak in PR #4123 — reduces KV cache miss penalty. small change, tests added.

Tess (Tech Lead): I'll review today in the afternoon window. Remind me if I miss it.

Marco (Infra): Slipped: embeddings infra (vpc peering + subnet mapping) hit an unexpected /21 overlap during integration tests. ETA +2w to finish the CIDR realignment and infra rollout.

Sara (PM): Thanks Marco. Customer impact? Any mitigation for Enterprise tenants?

Marco (Infra): Enterprise Dedicated tenants: some long-running embedding jobs may see degraded throughput until we finish. We can route new requests to hosted embeddings as a fallback for non-sensitive data.

Jamie (Eng): We can enable hosted fallback via routing rule 'embeddings-fallback' — config change is just a flip in org routing. No code change. @Sara do we want to enable it now?

Sara (PM): Yes for non-enterprise orgs. For enterprise, send a heads-up note — I'll draft a short notice.

Leah (Design): Docs & status page updates — I'll update the KB and the runbook. Assigning to myself for a short blurb.

Devin (Eng): PR updated after Tess's nits. Also added a unit test for cache key edge-case. PR: https://git.redwood-inference.com/runtime/pulls/4123

Tess (Tech Lead): Reviewed & approved. :white_check_mark: Devin — please squash and merge when CI passes.

Devin (Eng): Squashed and merged. Rolling canary to 20% now. Command used:
```
redwoodctl rollout create --service runtime --tag v2-canary --traffic 20
```

Oncall Bot: Canary rollout started — 20% traffic to runtime:v2-canary. Monitoring on alerting channel.

Sara (PM): Great. Quick summary / next steps:
- Shipped: runtime-v2 canary (Jamie/Devin/Tess) — monitor metrics next 48h.
- Slipped: embeddings infra (Marco) — ETA +2w; fallback enabled for non-enterprise.
- Docs: Leah to update KB + status page.
- Customer comms: Sara to draft enterprise heads-up.

Please add any blockers here by EOD. If none, I'll consolidate into the roadmap doc tomorrow AM. Thanks! :pray:
